race.comment: PRESSZORA (8) made an encouraging return at Rockhampton, sticking on well after trying to lead all the way, finishing within striking distance of the winner in fourth place. He has since joined the Kevin Miller stable, and with that run under his belt, she can take this out, especially with 4.5kg less to carry. UPSTART LEGEND (3) charged home to score impressively at Townsville last time and, with the aid of the pole position, she has the talent to repeat the dose despite meeting another competitive line-up. MR SHORTY (2) needed his first run from the Lachie Manzelmann stable, and he has been a winner second up in the past. If he can find the form he showed in Victoria as a younger horse, then he would go close to winning this. MAXIMUM POWER (6) has the ability to make his presence felt if he produces his best, while ASTRA STAR (1) has been remarkably consistent this prep and, despite dropping back in trip, remains a solid each-way proposition.
